page.notes: The right-hand strip shows the edge of the neighbouring printed page and is not transcribed. Show-through and stains on the left page were ignored. Hyphenated line-end words are kept with their printed hyphens. The mark "a" in the text stands before the italic word "Primatus" and is carried by the marginal note. Some letters in the scan are faint, notably "reiecisse" and the punctuation after it, which I read as a colon. The note text "Donatist." is partly blurred and is transcribed as best read.
